items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: Big band music, especially like Frank Sinatra. And he liked Tony Bennett too, Ella, Louis Armstrong he used to listen to Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Well there’s a strong musical culture from both of those populations, and I wonder if it had any effect in your home?

Well my dad didn’t play music but he played the hi fi. Every day he was always listening to music you know. Big band music, especially like Frank Sinatra. And he liked Tony Bennett too, Ella, Louis Armstrong he used to listen to Louis Armstrong. He never got into Bird and the bebop thing. That was the generation after him. But my mom played piano and used to be a professional dancer before she was married. She used to dance
flamenco and traditional Mexican dance, and she ended up playing castanets on one of my records you know.
